items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I don't know which one he used to hang out with, but they used to hang out all the time.

ctx.x: They did, yeah, but I'm sure that Lester was older than Oscar, because I met Oscar later on when I was playing, but I think he had some brothers or something; they did have a family band.
There was 11 children. I looked the Pettifords up after you mentioned him.
Yes, they did have a family band, because I know Lester used to -- I don't know which one he used to hang out with, but they used to hang out all the time.
